name: How do I compare two luxury remodeling bids correctly?

mainEntity.name: How should I compare two or more high-end remodeling bids?
mainEntity.text: How should I compare two or more high-end remodeling bids?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury remodeling bids are easy to misread because totals can look similar while the actual scope differs dramatically. Homeowners should compare line items, allowances, and exclusions instead of focusing on the bottom line. Ask whether each contractor included permits, demolition, protection, supervision, cleanup, temporary utilities, and final punch list work. Compare the quality level assumed for cabinetry, tile, stone, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and appliances. Also check whether the schedule is realistic and whether the contractor has included enough time for procurement and inspections. If one bid is much lower, it often means the scope is incomplete or the allowances are too small. A careful comparison should also review who is responsible for design coordination and how change orders are handled. The goal is not to pick the lowest price but to find the most complete and dependable proposal for the desired finish level.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare high-end remodeling bids by scope, allowances, finishes, exclusions, schedule, and project management details. The cheapest bid may leave out site protection, permitting, design coordination, or quality control. Use a line-by-line review to confirm each proposal covers the same work and the same level of finish.
